test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two differeent positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50f6ca0cd59628dd0ae30e3712cd4237f56cafe6c650636d7cffd174f08c551c.png]
solution:
Given two positions:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50f6ca0cd59628dd0ae30e3712cd4237f56cafe6c650636d7cffd174f08c551c.png] 

The logic applied here is:

**When only one face is common between two same dice, then the number which can't be seen is the number opposite to the common face.**

 
• So, only 5 is common between both dice.
 
• And we have 6, 3 on one dice and 1, 4 on other dice.
 
• The only number which can't be seen is 2.
 
• Hence, the number opposite to common face 5 is 2.

Hence, **option 1)** is the correct answer.
